return_owner: pop origin_route（允许来源：/pages/profile/index）；无历史实例时 replace /pages/profile/index，不创建伪造实体

assets.dynamic_media: 以用户/照片/活动/歌曲实体引用 manifest 中的本地图片；音频不存在时明确不可用

contracts.preconditions: Hydrated current account; unchanged full auth context; valid entity IDs; no duplicate pending write
contracts.visible_feedback: Source UI; custom 500ms Loading before writes; no write for reading/navigation/selection
contracts.store_action: Existing canonical Store getter/action; mappings in cimoa-profile-account-loop.md and cimoa-safety-settings-coins-contract.md
contracts.success_result: Only validated owned entities persist; return to exact source; unavailable services cannot succeed
contracts.failure_result: Retain prior data/draft, show error; abort stale/hide scope
contracts.persistence: settings; user_accounts; session; permissions; blocked_users; support_requests
contracts.sync_scope: All same-ID consumers and refresh; privacy/block/ledger applied consistently
contracts.acceptance: Browser/WK source geometry, default/empty/error/long/refresh/back, rollback, account change, Loading and duplicates
